title: Social-variance defensive exposure replay
claim: The frozen BLIND_VALIDATED social-attention one-hour variance forecast improves costed defensive exposure sizing over the frozen market-only variance scaler in the already-open July 2026 Binance panel.
mechanism: Social attention identifies information arrival and forecastable variance; reducing, but never increasing, equal-weight long exposure during high predicted variance may improve downside risk and certainty equivalent without requiring return direction.
target: Annualized certainty equivalent with risk aversion gamma 4 for a ten-asset equal-weight long portfolio after observed Binance funding and frozen turnover stresses.
horizon: Hourly decisions and next-hour returns during 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z/2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.
informationSet: Frozen social-attention and market-only one-hour variance forecasts from model set SHA-256 70d73e2f3c12d05b0d31cc5460b6b97fd113e692f85e61f698a8835b009fb983
Official Binance July 2026 fundingRate archives with publisher checksums
primaryBaseline: The same de-risk-only volatility scaler using the frozen market-only variance forecast.

evidence.summary: Social-aware sizing lost 0.1224 and 0.1260 annualized certainty-equivalent units to market-only sizing at 5 and 10 bps. Expected shortfall and maximum drawdown were also worse at both costs, so the frozen phase-two gate failed.

nextAction: Preserve the rejection. Do not launch the volatility-conditioned signed-social family under this program; require a materially distinct mechanism and separately registered evidence path.
